why: The criterion holds for all five expect lines. Each one runs in the repo at the PR head: three node -e checks for the empty list, non-empty lists and exports; `npm run lint && npm test`; and a regression check that swaps in `git show main:math.js` and confirms `node --test` exits non-zero, then restores the file. Each line yields one clear exit-status answer, and each proof is "run" with exact commands at the PR head. No line needs a release, deploy, published page or version bump; publishing is listed under non_goals. The main branch exists before merge, so the line 4 swap check works pre-merge. One thing outside this criterion: the problem names src/stats.js while every command uses ./math.js. That mismatch is a consistency issue, not a reason the lines can't be checked before merge.
